subject: Digital Electronics
topic: Boolean Theorems and Basics of Gates (Part-2)
questionText:
Which of the following is true?
(a) We can use '1' as enable input for OR gate
(b) We can use '0' as enable input for AND
gate
(c) '0' as well as '1' can be used as enable input
for XNOR gate
(d) None of the these
[MCQ]

options.text: We can use '1' as enable input for OR gate
We can use '0' as enable input for AND
'0' as well as '1' can be used as enable input

explanation: Practice Question from Digital Electronics DPP-02 (Boolean Theorems and Basics of Gates (Part-2)).
